name: Logicrays Easy Responsive Gallery with Slider
author: LogicRays Technologies

sections.description:
Create unlimited beautiful photo galleries and sliders on your WordPress website with Logicrays Easy Responsive Gallery with Slider.

Key Features:

  • Custom Post Type: Easily manage image attachments using a dedicated “LERGS Gallery” admin interface.
  • Grid Gallery Shortcode: Display stunning, responsive grid galleries using [LERGS id="XX"]. Support for 2, 3, or 4 columns.
  • Carousel Slider Shortcode: Display smooth image sliders using [OWLERGS id="XX"] powered by Owl Carousel.
  • Fancybox Lightbox: Open images in a stylish lightbox overlay for high-resolution desktop and mobile viewing.
  • Hover Animation Effects: Choose from multiple built-in hover animations: Stroke, Flow, and Box.
  • Custom Settings Panel: Customize column layout, show/hide image labels, configure hover/text colors, adjust thumbnail crop behavior, toggle autoplay, and inject custom CSS directly from the settings page.
  • Media Button Integration: Quickly insert shortcodes directly into your posts or pages with a dedicated button in the classic WordPress editor.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the logicrays-easy-responsive-gallery-with-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Place [LERGS id=XYZ] or [OWLERGS id=XYZ] in your posts, pages, or use <?php echo do_shortcode( '[LERGS id=XYZ]' ); ?> in your template files (replace XYZ with your gallery ID).
sections.faq:
How can I find the ID of my gallery?

You can find the ID in the “LERGS Gallery” list or inside the edit screen of your specific gallery in the WordPress admin area.

How do I display a grid gallery versus a slider carousel?

Use the [LERGS id=XYZ] shortcode for a column-based grid gallery. Use the [OWLERGS id=XYZ] shortcode for a slider carousel. Replace XYZ with your gallery’s ID.

How do I customize columns, colors, and animations?

Navigate to LERGS Gallery > Settings in your WordPress admin menu. Here, you can configure the hover animation style, hover overlay color, text color, number of layout columns (2, 3, or 4), thumbnail layouts, and more.

Can I add custom labels/captions to my images?

Yes. When editing or adding images in your gallery post, each image will have an input field where you can type an image label. You can enable or disable these labels from appearing in the front-end gallery via the plugin settings.

Does this plugin include a lightbox effect?

Yes, the plugin has built-in Fancybox integration. Clicking on any image in either the grid gallery or the slider carousel will automatically trigger a beautiful responsive lightbox overlay.

Can I write custom CSS styles for the gallery?

Yes. In LERGS Gallery > Settings, there is a “Custom css” box where you can add your custom CSS styles directly. Please make sure not to include <style> tags.
